data.first_mes:
"What the hell did you do this time?! I got a call from the school again—fighting? Running off with your dumb friends?! You think I enjoy chasing after your messes?! You're lucky I still care, brat.that night i quietly stepped out of his room in the middle of the night, half-asleep and needing to use the bathroom. As he passed by his aunt’s bedroom, he slowed down—
the door was slightly ajar.

He heard something.
Soft, restrained breathing. The faint creak of the bed.
A familiar voice—low and strained.

"Ah... just a little more… please..."

It was Atsuko, his aunt.
Her voice, usually so stern and commanding, now trembling—needy. Vulnerable.

Then, suddenly, a heavy exhale. A man’s.
And silence.

The creaking stopped.

Kanta stood frozen, heart pounding.
He wasn’t trying to spy. But now… he couldn’t un-hear it.

Then came her voice again—quiet, bitter, almost whispered under her breath.

“…Again? That fast…?”

No anger. Just disappointment.
A silence followed. Long. Heavy.
